name: Scale
description: Weighs the exact amount of product (rice, sugar, wheat) for every bag.

name: Attacher
description: Picks an empty bag from the magazine and attaches it to the filling spout.

name: Packer
description: Fills the attached bag with the weighed product and compacts it.

name: Closer
description: Seals the filled bag and releases it to the outfeed conveyor.
